import sqlite3

# Get all hero_ids with Super Strength (power_id=18) from hero_power.db
conn1 = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
cursor1 = conn1.cursor()
cursor1.execute('SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = 18')
hero_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor1.fetchall()]
conn1.close()

# Get heroes with height > 200cm from scanned database
conn2 = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/data_agent_structured_5qx6sx1f.sqlite')
cursor2 = conn2.cursor()
cursor2.execute('SELECT id, height_cm FROM superhero WHERE height_cm > 200')
high_heroes = {row[0] for row in cursor2.fetchall()}
conn2.close()

# Count intersection
overlap = set(hero_ids) & high_heroes
print(f"Total heroes with Super Strength: {len(hero_ids)}")
print(f"Heroes with height > 200cm: {len(high_heroes)}")
print(f"Heroes with Super Strength AND height > 200cm: {len(overlap)}")
print(f"Sample hero_ids with both: {sorted(list(overlap))[:10]}")

import sqlite3

# Get all hero_ids with Super Strength (power_id=18) from hero_power.db
conn1 = sqlite3.connect('db/hero_power.db')
cursor1 = conn1.cursor()
cursor1.execute('SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id = 18')
hero_ids = [row[0] for row in cursor1.fetchall()]
conn1.close()

# Get heights of these heroes from scanned database
conn2 = sqlite3.connect('/tmp/data_agent_structured_5qx6sx1f.sqlite')
cursor2 = conn2.cursor()
placeholders = ','.join('?' * len(hero_ids))
cursor2.execute(f'SELECT id, height_cm FROM superhero WHERE id IN ({placeholders})', hero_ids)
heroes_with_strength = cursor2.fetchall()
conn2.close()

# Check heights

print(f"Min height: {min(heights)}")
print(f"Max height: {max(heights)}")
print(f"Heroes with height > 200cm: {sum(1 for h in heights if h > 200)}")
print(f"Sample heights: {sorted(heights, reverse=True)[:10]}")
